memory_recovered: Continuity identity is conjunctive rather than resemblance-based: assignment evidence, namespace, owner, semantic role, temporal precedence, immutable locator, and sufficient coverage must agree before an M-series artifact can be classified as resolved.
contradiction_resolved: A candidate may be semantically similar and still fail provenance. Conversely, incomplete coverage does not prove the candidate false; it preserves unresolved status. Rejected collision and unresolved are therefore distinct outcomes.
